claim: The new last step of `MeasureTheory.Measure.pi_map_piCongrLeft` closes `∏ i, μ (e i) (s' i) = ∏ i, μ i (s i)` with `Fintype.prod_equiv _ _ _ (congrFun rfl)`, i.e. `Fintype.prod_equiv` with a trivial `h` (spelled oddly as `congrFun rfl`) and the equivalence `e` left to higher-order unification. The switch from `rw [this, pi_pi, ...]` to `simp only [pi_pi, this]` is also unnecessary: the plain `rw` still works.
requested_change: Replace the last two lines `simp only [pi_pi, this]` / `exact Fintype.prod_equiv _ _ _ (congrFun rfl)` with `rw [this, pi_pi]` / `exact e.prod_comp fun i ↦ μ i (s i)`. At the very least, write `Fintype.prod_equiv e _ _ fun _ ↦ rfl` and not `_ _ _ (congrFun rfl)`.
